title: Retained imported shared notes export as stored without the author policy reapplied
outcome: Retained imported shared notes export as stored without the author policy reapplied
acceptance: A decision records whether retained (previously imported) shared notes whose author would now be refused by the author policy keep exporting as stored, are omitted with a counted reason, or need another treatment, consistent with how retained activity is already filtered on export
If filtering is chosen, a test shows a retained note with a path-shaped author omitted on export with no body or id in the shared bytes, and stored rows unchanged
